project_name: PT. Geya Mora Agung (GMA) Landing Page & Admin

theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (adapted for Corporate Maritime/Industrial)
theme_and_archetype.reasoning: GMA is an integrated maritime, trading, and construction group. The design must convey extreme reliability, immense scale, and institutional authority. Archetype 4 provides the structural rigidity and clarity needed for B2B trust, paired with deep maritime blues and industrial safety orange.

colors.guidelines: Use the accent color (#FF5A1F) strictly for CTA buttons, hover states, and critical notification badges. Never use it as a large background fill. The primary tone should dominate the visual space to establish maritime authority.

rules.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-semibold tracking-tighter leading-none
rules.general: Do not use Inter or Roboto. Emphasize optical alignment. Headings must have strong tension with tight letter-spacing.

grids.services: Bento Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Use sharp geometric layouts. No soft shadows. Use 1px borders.
grids.sectors: Masonry Layout: columns-1 md:columns-2 lg:columns-3 gap-6 space-y-6. Images must stretch full width of their column.
grids.why_us: Control Room Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8. High density, data-correlation vibe.

surfaces.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-slate-200/dark:border-slate-800), zero border-radius (rounded-none). Hover: -translate-y-1, border-accent.
surfaces.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 (light) or bg-[#050914]/80 (dark). 1px delicate bottom border.
surfaces.footer: Contrast Shift: If light mode, footer must be solid dark (#0A1128). py-24.

navigation.style: Sticky at top (z-50). Must include actual circular SVG flags for language switcher (IND/ENG), no emojis.
navigation.behavior: Scroll-shrink effect: py-6 shrinks to py-3 on scroll. Smooth transition.

buttons.primary: bg-accent text-white rounded-none px-8 py-4 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider hover:bg-accent/90 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-primary border-2 border-primary rounded-none px-8 py-4 font-semibold hover:bg-primary hover:text-white transition-colors

language_switcher.design: Toggle or dropdown using pure SVG circular flags (🇮🇩 for ID, 🇬🇧 for EN). Must look premium, align right next to dark mode toggle.

forms.inputs: Shadcn-based but strictly sharp edges (rounded-none). Focus state: ring-2 ring-accent border-transparent.

admin_panel.layout: Sidebar (w-64) + Content area. Use Shadcn tables for Blog/Contacts. Strict, clean white/slate-50 background.

animations_and_interactions.hero: Parallax effect on the background Belawan port image. Elements fade up on load.
animations_and_interactions.scroll_reveal: Use Framer Motion. 'whileInView' with opacity 0 to 1, y: 20 to 0. Stagger children in grids.
animations_and_interactions.ticker: Use react-fast-marquee for a subtle, slow 'Editorial Ribbon' of client/partner logos or service keywords.
animations_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must explicitly define hover colors to ensure high contrast.

treatment.hero_overlay: bg-primary/60 gradient to transparent to ensure text readability.
treatment.general: Images should have minimal filtering to convey authenticity. Use max-h-[80vh] for hero on mobile to prevent extreme stretching.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text over images or dark backgrounds passes APCA and WCAG AA standard (4.5:1).
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: Mandatory on all interactive elements. Example: data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='lang-switcher-ind', data-testid='contact-form-submit'.
accessibility_and_testing.aria: Add aria-labels to the Language Switcher, Dark Mode Toggle, and all social links.

seo_and_meta.meta_tags: Include bilingual meta titles/descriptions. Primary keyword: PT Geya Mora Agung, Integrated Maritime Trading Medan.
seo_and_meta.schema_org: Implement JSON-LD for Organization (GMA), LocalBusiness (Jl. Bambu 18H location), and BlogPosting for the dynamic articles.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install specific fonts: Clash Display and IBM Plex Sans. Use next/font or standard imports.
Install dependencies: framer-motion, react-fast-marquee, lucide-react, react-i18next (or similar for translation), next-themes (for dark mode).
Develop the App using .js/.jsx. Do not use TS.
Set up pure SVG icons for the language flags. Ensure they are circular and have no bounding box distortions.
Embed Google Map for coordinates matching 'Jl. Bambu 18H, Gaharu, Medan Timur' in the contact section.
Develop a functional mock for the Admin Panel showing a dashboard with Sidebar, Blog Post CRUD, and Contact Submissions table.
For Services section, implement the 8 KBLI-coded items: Commodity Trading, Shipbuilding, Warehousing, Construction, Marine Equipment, Garment, Brokerage, General Trading.
Strictly follow the color tokens and zero border-radius rule for a sharp, industrial aesthetic.
